title: 第三章太平要术第四章猝炼身躯

第三章《太平要术》
今日两更，下午还有一章！求点推荐，收藏，点击……总之希望有条件的都能帮忙点下！
“风紧，撤呼！”在又一次吞噬完投奔自己的幽灵后，周围的一只小骷髅突然注意到了陈林！虽然对方只有一阶的实力，但是陈林因为没有还击死亡能力，还是只能跑路了。
陈林现在自己很苦恼，自己现在经常会被欺负，而且还有些是比自己阶位低的亡灵。但是自己却没有什么还手的能力，只能不断的逃跑。这让陈林心里很不舒服！
“必须赶紧想办法，要不然自己闯荡异界的理想就破灭了！”
现在陈林的实力虽然是二阶，但是陈林却没有什么攻击能力。而普通的幽灵是通过数量的优势来和别的亡灵对抗的，但是陈林为了提升实力把别的幽灵都吞噬了，根本没有什么数量……
“看来还是得从自己身上找出路啊。”陈林自己这样想着，渐渐的陈林将自己的的全部精神力放到了自己的‘身体’里，慢慢的感受自己体内的能量，突然陈林‘看到’自己的‘体内’有一个东西……
这个东西是一团柔和的黄光，黄光虽然柔和却怎么也看不清里面是什么！但陈林却能感觉到，这正是前世无意中得到的东西――黄符！
陈林知道自己之所以会到这里，和这道黄符有着必然的联系。所以陈林就决定要探探这个黄符的究竟！于是就用自己的意念慢慢的进入黄光里……
在进入黄光后，陈林感觉自己进入了另一个空间一般。在这个空间里黄光萦绕，似幻似仙仿佛是仙境又仿佛是幻境！
在这个空间里到处都充满了玄奥的文字图案，这些玄奥的文字图案游离在空中构成了这个空间，它们不断的变化这，仿佛在解释这宇宙大道法则！
当陈林看向这些文字图案的时候，就立即被这些吸引住了目光。陈林虽然不认识这些文字也看不懂图案，但是他却实实在在的能感觉到这些文字图案所传递过来的信息，现在的陈林仿佛在接受某种承传……
当陈林再一次清醒过来的时候，自己的实力又退回了一阶的水平，但是陈林却没有沮丧，而且还很高兴因为这次陈林得到的好处是无法估量的，“没想到，一张普通的黄符竟然这么有来头，这次真是捡到宝了！”
其实，黄符只是普通朱砂写的道符，但是道符上的符文却大有来头，它是远古是的一位大能飞升前留下一本书中的符文，这本书正是陈林前世古代的赫赫有名的――《太平要术》。
要说《太平要术》大家可能不知道，但是汉末时期的黄巾起义大家都知道，而黄巾军的领袖张角就是因为得到这本书才有了如此成就。
本来黄符是只有辟邪作用的道符，在机缘巧合的情况下被陈林激发了道符上的符文，带着陈林穿越至此，并被陈林参悟！虽然只是《太平要术》中的一部分，但却让陈林获益良多，最重要的是让陈林有了一条提升的道路！
陈林的这次参悟得到了很多的神通，不过现在的陈林却大多都不能使用，因为现在的陈林是灵魂状态，只是个幽灵！不过有两个神通却是很实用！一个是灵魂修炼功法，一个是符咒契约！
灵魂修炼功法名叫神魂决，功法共分三大层，分别是凡魂阶、识魂阶、神魂阶。每个阶段又分为六个小阶段分别是入门、初级、中级、高级、大成、巅峰。
神魂决顾名思义就是修炼灵魂的方法，它是通过不断的锤炼自己的灵魂，从而产生神识之海孕育神魂，达到通天彻地的能力。
但是神魂决和普通的修炼功法不一样，别的修炼功法只能通过天地灵气滋养灵魂，慢慢的一步步成长，而神魂决却是通过不断的凝练自己的灵魂，吸收天地间的魂力来提升自己的灵魂，而且神魂决还有能快速提升灵魂之力的方法，那就是吸收别人的信仰之力和炼化其它生灵的灵魂。

当年张角正式通过神魂决，不断的吸收信徒的信仰之力，快速提升自身的实力。从而成了能呼风唤雨的大贤良师。将有者几百年根基的大汉搅得天翻地覆。
在异界《太平要术》中并不是所有的神通都能施展，有的神通因为和异界的法则相互冲突，所以神通的威力被压制。有的冲突厉害的甚至会遭到异界法则的排斥，直接让施法者反噬而亡。
但是神魂决不但没有和法则相互冲突，而且在这个亡灵界却如鱼得水。这里虽说没有信仰之力可以吸收，但是却又着无数的亡灵的灵魂碎片可以炼化！
而另一可神通是一个符咒契约，这个符咒契约名叫禁魂咒，这个禁魂咒是《太平要术》中控制信徒的一种符咒契约。它是通过让人吞食符咒完成的一种契约，当然也可以在对方灵魂不反抗的情况下直接施展。
被施展禁魂咒的人，生死大权就被掌握在施法者的手中。而且被施法者会施法者言听计从，视若真神永远不会背叛，成为施法者的傀儡。而禁魂咒可契约的人数和自己的灵魂强度有关。灵魂之力越强能通过禁魂咒控制的人越厉害越多。
神魂决和禁魂咒这两个神通相辅相成，缺一不可。神魂咒来提升自身的灵魂之力，从而增加可以控制的人数；而禁魂咒又可以通过控制信徒，得到更多的信仰之力来提升神魂咒的修为。
当年的张角正式通过这两个神通，不断的控制了信徒，增加自己的实力，并组织了黄巾军发动了黄军起义。要不是因为张角草之过急，只此两个神通绝对能改朝换代自立为王。
陈林以为是自己在灵魂中直接参悟到的两个神通，要比当年的张角自己修炼的要深刻的多。所以只要给陈林足够的时间，陈林绝对会像张角一样，把异界搅得天翻地覆。
陈林自己从惊喜中清醒过来后，开是冷静下来！自己虽然参悟到了《太平要术》中的神通，但是自己现在的实力太弱小，并且还是灵魂状态的幽灵。
“现在要紧的是抓紧时间提升实力，免得自己还没有什么成就就夭折了。还有就是再弄一副身躯，老是以灵魂状态做起事来很不方便，还是有身.体的好，那怕是亡灵的身躯。”
接着陈林开始查看自己现在的状态，自己由于参悟了神魂决，所以自己的灵魂自主的开始了修炼，并且直接越过了入门级别，已经是凡魂阶初级的修为了。
现在陈林已经由一个白色的气团，变成了一团淡黄色的灵魂火焰！而在这个世界的实力却从以前的二阶初级，降到了一阶的实力。不过能力却因为灵魂更加的凝实，实力不降反增。现在自己有信心可以打败，以前的老欺负自己的骷髅了。
“小骷髅们你们等着，我要你们好看！”

Chapter 3 "The Art of Peace"
Two updates today, and another chapter in the afternoon! Please recommend, collect, click... In short, I hope everyone who has the conditions can help click!
"The wind is tight, withdraw the call!" After once again devouring the ghosts that defected to him, a small skeleton around him suddenly noticed Chen Lin! Although the opponent only had first-level strength, Chen Lin had no choice but to run away because he did not have the ability to fight back with death.
Chen Lin is very distressed now. He is often bullied, and some of them are undead that are lower than himself. But he had no ability to fight back and could only keep running away. This made Chen Lin feel very uncomfortable!
"We must find a way quickly, otherwise our dream of entering another world will be shattered!"
Although Chen Lin's strength is now at the second level, Chen Lin has no offensive ability. Ordinary ghosts fight against other undead through the advantage of numbers, but Chen Lin swallowed up all the other ghosts in order to increase his strength, so there was no quantity at all...
"It seems that I still have to find a way out from myself." Chen Lin thought to himself. Gradually, Chen Lin put all his mental power into his 'body' and slowly felt the energy in his body. Suddenly Chen Lin 'saw' something inside his 'body'...
This thing is a soft yellow light. Although the yellow light is soft, it is impossible to see what is inside! But Chen Lin could feel that this was exactly what he had accidentally obtained in his previous life - the Yellow Talisman!
Chen Lin knew that the reason why he was here was inevitably connected with this yellow talisman. So Chen Lin decided to find out what happened to this yellow talisman! So I used my thoughts to slowly enter the yellow light...
After entering the yellow light, Chen Lin felt as if he had entered another space. The yellow light lingers in this space, making it seem like a fairyland and an illusion!
This space is filled with mysterious text patterns everywhere. These mysterious text patterns float in the air to form this space. They are constantly changing, as if they are explaining the laws of the universe!
When Chen Lin looked at these text patterns, he was immediately attracted by them. Although Chen Lin didn't recognize these words and couldn't understand the patterns, he could actually feel the information conveyed by these words and patterns. Now Chen Lin seemed to be accepting some kind of inheritance...
When Chen Lin woke up again, his strength had returned to the first level, but Chen Lin was not depressed, and was very happy because the benefits Chen Lin received this time were immeasurable. "I didn't expect that an ordinary yellow talisman would be so valuable. I really found a treasure this time!"
In fact, the yellow talisman is just a Taoist talisman written in ordinary cinnabar, but the runes on the Taoist talisman have a great origin. They are runes left in a book by a great power in ancient times before he ascended. This book is the famous "Essential Art of Taiping" written by Chen Lin in his previous life.
Everyone may not know "The Art of Taiping", but everyone knows about the Yellow Turban Uprising in the late Han Dynasty, and the leader of the Yellow Turban Army, Zhang Jiao, achieved such an achievement because he got this book.
It turns out that the yellow talisman is a Taoist talisman that can only ward off evil spirits. By chance, Chen Lin inspired the runes on the Taoist talisman, and took Chen Lin through time here, and was enlightened by Chen Lin! Although it is only a part of "The Art of Taiping", it has benefited Chen Lin a lot. The most important thing is that it has given Chen Lin a way to improve!
Chen Lin gained a lot of magical powers through this enlightenment, but now Chen Lin can't use most of them, because the current Chen Lin is in a soul state, just a ghost! But there are two magical powers that are very practical! One is a soul cultivation technique, and the other is a spell contract!
The soul cultivation technique is called Shenhun Jue, and the technique is divided into three levels, namely the ordinary soul level, the conscious soul level, and the divine soul level. Each stage is divided into six small stages: entry, preliminaryLevel, intermediate, advanced, dacheng, peak.
As the name suggests, Divine Soul Art is a method of cultivating the soul. It is to continuously temper one's soul, thereby generating a sea of ​​divine consciousness to nurture the divine soul, and to achieve the ability to reach the heaven and the earth.
However, the Divine Soul Art is different from ordinary cultivation techniques. Other cultivation techniques can only nourish the soul through the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and grow slowly step by step. However, the Divine Soul Art improves one's soul by constantly condensing one's own soul and absorbing the soul power between heaven and earth. Moreover, the Divine Soul Art also has a way to quickly increase the power of the soul, which is to absorb the power of other people's beliefs and refine the souls of other living beings.
That year, Zhang Jiao officially passed the Divine Soul Art, constantly absorbing the power of believers' faith and rapidly improving his own strength. Thus he became a great virtuous teacher who could call upon the wind and rain. The big man with hundreds of years of foundation was turned upside down.
Not all magical powers can be used in the alien world "Taiping Yashu". Some magical powers conflict with the laws of the alien world, so the power of the magical powers is suppressed. Some conflicts are so severe that they will even be rejected by the laws of other worlds, directly causing the caster to bite back and die.
But not only does the soul not conflict with the laws, but it is also at home in this world of the dead. Although there is no power of faith to absorb here, there are countless soul fragments of the undead that can be refined!
Another magical power is a talisman contract. This talisman contract is called the soul-forbidden curse. This soul-forbidden curse is a talisman contract used to control believers in "The Art of Taiping". It is a contract completed by letting people swallow the spell. Of course, it can also be cast directly without resistance from the other party's soul.
The power of life and death of the person who is cast the soul-forbidden spell is in the hands of the caster. Moreover, the person being cast by the spell will obey the spellcaster's words and regard him as a true god who will never betray him and become the caster's puppet. The number of people that can be contracted by the soul-forbidden spell is related to the strength of one's own soul. The stronger the power of the soul, the more powerful people can be controlled through the soul-forbidden spell.
The two magical powers, Divine Soul Art and Soul Forbidden Curse, complement each other and are indispensable. The Soul Curse can increase the power of one's own soul, thereby increasing the number of people it can control; and the Soul Forbidden Curse can gain more power of faith by controlling believers to improve the cultivation of the Soul Curse.
At that time, Zhang Jiao officially used these two magical powers to continuously control believers, increase his own strength, and organized the Yellow Turban Army to launch the Yellow Army Uprising. If it weren't for Zhang Jiaocao's haste, these two magical powers would definitely change the dynasty and establish himself as king.
Chen Lin thought that the two magical powers he had directly comprehended in his soul were much more profound than what Zhang Jiao had cultivated back then. So as long as Chen Lin is given enough time, Chen Lin will definitely turn the other world upside down like Zhang Jiao.
After Chen Lin woke up from the surprise, he calmed down! Although I have comprehended the magical powers in "The Art of Peace", my current strength is too weak, and I am still a ghost in the state of my soul.
"The most important thing now is to seize the time to improve your strength, so as not to die before you have achieved anything. The other thing is to get another body. It is very inconvenient to always do things in the soul state. It is better to have a body, even if it is the body of the undead."
Then Chen Lin began to check his current status. Since he had comprehended the Divine Soul Art, his soul began to practice independently, and he directly surpassed the entry level and was already at the elementary level of the mortal soul level.
Now Chen Lin has changed from a white air ball into a pale yellow soul flame! But the strength in this world has dropped from the previous second level to the first level. However, because his soul has become more solid, his ability has increased instead of decreasing. Now I am confident that I can defeat the skeleton who used to bully me.
"Little skeletons, just wait, I want you to look good!"
